replies.text: @trueglobe66 To me Bermuda's kept secret is ITS TRUST IN GOD! It is written "righteous exalts a nation" and Bermudans over the centuries have tried to do whats right! (Nowdays the negative influence of other nations has crept in!) A sample: We are in Hurricane Alley and MANY a Storm has been Prayed away! Sometimes we do get interesting sighns and sights like around 7:30  in the morning years ago everything was a Pink Haze like the Angels were present!, there have been thick rainbows as if coming out of the sea that were so Majestic that people didn't care being late for work one morning and just stopped and looked in Awe and Reverence! Have seen huge fire ball in the sky without no smell of gas Etc. Christopher Columbus also reported seeing some when passing us! We also have a Bay that was used as a Natural Storm Warning as the roaring from it would let you know a Storm was coming along with other natural sighns like the spider making its web low, or avocado delay, the birds after will tell you WHEN its safe to go out! Our Reefs protect us, we are the only land in the Sagasso Sea, We have Magnitite all around, Salt water is a healer, we've been Self Governing ever since the 1600's! i can go on and on but will stop here!
